title: IT team
description:
## Column contract — mapping to the coworker standing order (decided 2026-11-18, card e5df5856)

The standing order says *"first card in **To Do** → move it to **Doing** → … → **Review**"*. This board keeps its existing folder names (renaming moves every task folder and invalidates in-flight paths); the mapping below is the contract and is binding for every autonomous shift.

| Standard name | Column on this board | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| To Do | `Inbox` | new card, no work started, no wake scheduled |
| To Do (queued) | `Scheduled` | not started yet; `wake_at` decides when it becomes actionable |
| Doing | `Working` | in progress (status `doing`) or blocked (status `onhold` + the blocker written in a comment) |
| Review | `Review` | increment finished: comment carries the changed files and the validation evidence (command + result), awaiting a verdict |
| Done | `Done` | verdict accepted |

### Rules
1. An autonomous shift takes the first card of `Inbox`, then the `Scheduled` card with the earliest `wake_at`, and moves it to `Working` **before** touching files.
2. `wake_at` is the only autonomy trigger; a column is never a trigger.
3. The actor that did the work never closes its own card — `Review` → `Done` belongs to the reviewer/QA.
4. Blocked work goes to `Working` with status `onhold` and an explicit unblock hint; a card is not parked in `Review` merely because it is stuck.
5. Every card description carries context + one measurable acceptance criterion.
